selection_timing: documented after exploratory dev inspection and before any evaluations under this formal protocol; not a pre-exploration preregistration
selection_rule: among tested original-BF16 budgets256/512/1024, select highest fixed-seed42 internal-dev Overall with successful integrity/preflight and memory fit on current A10080GB; no business latency SLA provided; record cost and all supervised-frequency slices rather than claiming best in every subgroup
input: original pinned image/question task templates, no OCR reference tokens or human targets; references scored only after generation
training: none; reuse existing NF4/FP32-trained final qv_r8 adapters, cast original backbone/vision/head/LoRA to BF16 for inference
primary_question: under the frozen joint engineering path, does each existing SFT checkpoint improve formal TextVQA compared with the same-path base?

metrics.mmstar: pinned answer extractor and macro mean over all18 manifest subcategories

uncertainty: training-checkpoint mean and sampleSD reported separately from2000 paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals per seed/task; pointwise intervals unadjusted, conditional on fixed checkpoints; no seed-image pseudo-independence, equivalence or noninferiority claim
longtail_proxy: TextVQA official-val evaluation slices derived from train_all actual normalized SFT target counts and declared dev-independent modal-reference rule; reference coverage separately; not semantic visual-class long-tail or pretraining absence
resource_rule: one complete model/task worker per admitted idle A10080GB; three idle checks, >=40GiB free, utilization<10%, no compute processes; inherited UUID lock, no preemption; task-specific resource timing and contention tags
completion_rule: finish all12 cells regardless of outcome; no formal-score feedback to budgets/checkpoint/prompt/numerical path; partial MMStar counts do not become complete macro scores
historical_comparison: prior NF4/FP32 budget256 results remain separate; new-minus-old is a multi-factor engineering-package observation, not isolated BF16 or budget effect
scope: complete public validation benchmarks with known prior benchmark exposure and unknown pretraining overlap; same-path base comparison, three preexisting checkpoints with heterogeneous training hardware; no new training or clean unseen benchmark claim
